title: License Activation
subtitle: Thank you for purchasing Logic Indicators. Follow these simple steps to activate your tools on NinjaTrader 8.

step1.title: Get the Machine ID from your NinjaTrader 8
step1.description: The Machine ID is a unique alphanumeric code generated by NinjaTrader 8 for your PC. It is required to generate your official license.
instructions: In the top menu of the Control Center, click on Help.
Select About from the dropdown list.
Locate the Machine ID field, select it, copy the entire string, and paste it into the form.
step1.imageHint: Click the screenshot to zoom in and see the exact location.

step2.title: Submit your activation details
step2.subtitle: Enter the email address you used during purchase to properly link your license.
